$schema_note: Fixed, version-controlled per-engine export presets. Export stage (S13) is parameter-free at the call site; it reads a preset by key. Changing a preset is a reviewed commit. Every export is round-trip verified against qa-thresholds.export.

biped_gameready_v1.description: Standard game-ready biped, multi-LOD, skeletal + baked animation clips.

unity.notes: Unity imports meters at scale 1 when up=Y, forward=Z. leaf_bones off to match Unity avatar mapping.

unreal.notes: UE5 skeletal mesh expects a single root; Z-up X-forward avoids the 90deg import rotation.

godot.notes: glTF is Godot-native; glb embeds textures for a single-file import.

blender.notes: Authoring format; retains full data for re-processing.
